description: Misread My Leads.xlsx schema. Treated 'Passed To' column as the assigned AM destination. Actual meaning: the person who passed the lead to David (source). '---' means the lead was never passed and is dead, not unassigned. Wrote incorrect status notes to F column before being corrected.
correction: In My Leads.xlsx, 'Passed To' = who referred the lead to David. '---' = dead/unlogged lead. The tracker has no AM assignment column. Chase should not treat '---' entries as actionable unassigned leads.
systemic_fix: Update lead-review workflow and chase-call-prep skill to document the correct My Leads.xlsx schema: Year, Date, Client, Passed To (= referral source), Logo. Add a schema note to the lead-review workflow INITIALIZATION section so future runs interpret the data correctly.
